card.description: A towering 30‑meter obelisk carved from obsidian‑like basalt, etched with ancient Ethiopian and Egyptian glyphs that glow with bio‑luminescent nanolight, housing a pulsing azure crystalline core, topped with a translucent crystal solar array refracting light into a halo, surrounded by a ring of metallic plates with runic engravings, set within a subterranean chamber of stone walls, steam vents, and a central control console, photorealistic, cinematic, tactile, grounded realism, industrial mysticism, ancient‑tech fusion.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** 30 m monolith of weathered basalt, etched with intricate glyphs, capped with a translucent crystal solar array.
**Face/Sensors:** Embedded bio‑luminescent glyphs, crystalline core pulsing with azure light, sensor arrays on base.
**Key Features:** Pulsing core, solar crystal array, runic metal plates, steam vents, central control console.
evolution: Phase 1 (Initial Activation): Obelisk dormant, glyphs faint, core inactive.
Phase 2 (Full Activation): Glyphs glow, core pulses, solar array refracts light, chamber lights up.
props: Item: Central Control Console – stone slab with copper circuitry and holographic interface.
Item: Steam Vent – brass vent with etched runes releasing warm mist.
